# DETAILED MULTI-JURISDICTION REVIEW

| Jurisdiction | Authority | Trigger | Notice Procedure | Cure Standard | Remedy | Practical Analysis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nigeria | Companies and Allied Matters Act and contract | Material default supported by documented evidence | Written notice describing every default and the contractual response date | Complete remediation of each identified default within the stated period | Termination and damages subject to the agreed limitations | Review the correspondence, delivery record, waiver arguments, mitigation evidence, and each jurisdiction-specific enforcement risk before action. |
| England | Governing agreement and common law | Repudiatory breach or an express contractual trigger | Clear and unequivocal notice compliant with the service clause | Cure must address the substantive breach rather than only promise future performance | Acceptance of breach, termination, and a damages claim | Preserve election evidence and avoid conduct that could affirm the agreement while the termination decision remains under review. |
